## About
Daily Driven Auto Repair is a car repair and maintenance shop on Donelson Pike in Nashville. We're open every day of the week, so when your car starts acting up on the way home from work, we're here.
One driver pulled in thinking we were a car wash and found a mechanic shop instead. That's fine by us. Come by, tell us what's going on, and we'll explain what your car needs and what it will cost before we get to work.

## Services
- Fuel sensor and electric brake switch: A burned-out fuel sensor and an electric brake switch were throwing off one customer's acceleration and speed. We replaced both.
- New tires: Need tires along with other work? One customer picked up a new set during the same visit.
- Fixing wrecked cars: We fix wrecked cars, and one customer brings us all of theirs, especially Mopars.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes. We're open every day, Monday through Sunday, from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Q: What if it's a quick fix?
A: One reviewer pulled in with a loose skid plate on the way to class. The mechanic came right out, looked at it, and had them in and out in under 10 minutes.

Q: Can you help me find parts?
A: Yes. One customer told us we helped them source parts at a good price, along with doing the work on their cars.
